howItWorks.title: How BloodAccess Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Built for emergencies. Reach verified voluntary donors in 3 simple steps.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Voluntary donors register once with their blood group, city, and contact preference. Takes under 2 minutes.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Search available donors in your city. View verified status and last donation date without privacy leaks.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Verify your phone via OTP to contact donors instantly by direct phone call or prefilled WhatsApp message.

trust.title: Why You Can Trust Us
trust.subtitle: Designed with strict privacy safeguards and zero commercial interest.
trust.feature1Desc: Donor phone numbers are NEVER publicly visible. They are revealed only after a requester verifies their own phone with OTP.
trust.feature2Desc: Every single contact request requires instant SMS OTP verification to prevent spam, telemarketers, and misuse.
trust.feature3Desc: No subscription, no convenience fee, no selling blood. We strictly follow National Blood Transfusion Council ethics.
trust.feature4Desc: Donors can toggle their availability on/off anytime with one tap, or take cooldown breaks between donations.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear answers for voluntary donors and families seeking blood.
faq.donorQ1: Who can become a blood donor?
faq.donorA1: Any healthy individual between 18 and 65 years of age, weighing at least 45 kg, with no active blood-borne infection. Final eligibility is verified at the blood bank.
faq.donorQ2: Will my mobile number be visible publicly on the internet?
faq.donorA2: No. Never. Your phone number is strictly private. Only an emergency requester who has verified their own mobile number via OTP can view your contact details.
faq.donorQ3: What is the recommended cooldown period between donations?
faq.donorA3: Generally, 90 days (3 months) for men and 120 days (4 months) for women. Your dashboard automatically manages your cooldown status so you aren't disturbed.
faq.donorQ4: Can I pause my availability or delete my profile?
faq.donorA4: Yes, absolutely. You have a 1-tap availability toggle in your donor dashboard. You can also permanently delete your account and all stored data anytime in accordance with India's DPDP Act.
faq.reqQ1: Is BloodAccess completely free of charge?
faq.reqA1: Yes, 100% free. BloodAccess never charges requesters or donors. Selling or buying blood is illegal in India under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act.
faq.reqQ2: How quickly can I reach a donor?
faq.reqA2: Search results show available donors immediately. Once you enter the patient's blood group, hospital, and verify your OTP, you get direct Call and WhatsApp buttons within seconds.
faq.reqQ3: What should I do if this is a critical emergency?
faq.reqA3: While searching on BloodAccess, please also immediately inform your treating hospital's blood bank and coordinate with official district blood centers.
faq.reqQ4: Why do I have to verify my phone number with OTP?
faq.reqA4: To protect our generous voluntary donors from nuisance calls, spammers, and commercial blood agents. Each requester can reveal contact for up to 5 donors per 24 hours.

register.title: Become a Voluntary Blood Donor
register.subtitle: Join India's voluntary donor network. One registration can help save up to 3 lives.
register.otpHelp: Use Supabase configured phone number / test credentials.
register.healthItem1: I am in good health today (no fever, cold, or ongoing infection).
register.healthItem2: No major surgery, tattoo, or piercing in the last 6 months.
register.healthItem3: Not currently pregnant, breastfeeding, or on blood-thinning medication.
register.healthDisclaimer: Note: Final clinical eligibility is determined by medical staff at the blood bank.
register.consentMandatory: I agree to be contacted by people who need blood. My phone number is shown only after they verify their phone number with OTP.
register.consentOptional: Send me periodic eligibility reminders when I can donate again and alerts for urgent city blood shortages.
register.ageUnder18: Thank you for your noble desire to donate! For your safety and legal protection, voluntary blood donation in India requires donors to be at least 18 years old. Please join us as soon as you turn 18!
register.ageOver65: Thank you for your incredible spirit of service! National guidelines set 65 as the upper limit for voluntary donors to safeguard health. You can still save lives by inspiring friends and family to register!
register.weightUnder45: For your physical safety and well-being, donors must weigh at least 45 kg to safely donate a unit of blood. Please take good care of your health and register once your weight reaches 45 kg.
register.successSubtitle: Your voluntary donor registration is complete and active on BloodAccess.
register.donorCardTagline: Ready to save lives when called upon.
register.shareMessage: I just registered as a voluntary blood donor on BloodAccess! Join me to help save lives: https://bloodaccess.org
